scope: Independent local correctness audit of benchmark workload; not an official assessment or performance result
sql_hash_encoding: UTF-8; per-statement SHA excludes terminator newline; sequence SHA concatenates each SQL statement followed by one LF

workload_capture.scope: Mock transport compares SQL text only. It does not execute SQL and is not database correctness evidence.

oracle.method: Parse exact SQL vector JSON literals; cast coordinates to float32, promote to float64; exhaustive L2 for all rows; apply predicate, lexsort(distance, primary_key)
oracle.sampling: none; every one of 1000 queries and every returned distance is checked
oracle.timing: No audit or oracle time is reported as a performance score
